question: Does the frozen minimal clean support retain the pooled interface's bidirectional robustness to 10% cue-source noise?

authority.rank46_support: The hash-corrected greedy result selects the 46-site support after removing L1H3 and L3H7.
authority.rank45_boundary: The sole remaining declared deletion L10H5 misses the frozen behavior threshold at .799723, closing the clean greedy branch at rank46.
authority.rank48_noise: The parent rank48 pooled interface passed all three 10% source-noise seeds in both directions.

evaluation: Using the frozen 46-site support and identical pooled projector, perturb only the exchanged cue embedding by 10% of its clean displacement norm for seeds 1729, 2718, and 3141; evaluate forward and reverse on disjoint temporal-v12/iswas-v11 targets and matched controls.

predictions.pred_a_authority_hash_noise_tripwire_fin: Rank46 correction and rank45 boundary are hash-bound, support count is 46, projector/disjointness/noise/finiteness tripwires pass, and exactly 39 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_all_noisy_bidirectional_coordinat: Every seed and direction has minimum coordinate projection at least 0.75 and mean/worst residual at most 0.20.
predictions.pred_c_all_noisy_bidirectional_behaviors: Every seed and direction has both behavior projections at least 0.80 and worst target residual at most 0.15.
predictions.pred_d_all_noisy_bidirectional_controls_: Every seed and direction has margin RMS at most 0.10, median full-vocabulary KL at most 0.02, and zero top-one control flips.
predictions.pred_e_seed_and_direction_stability: Within-direction seed ranges and paired forward/reverse behavior gaps are each at most 0.08.

decision: A 5/5 pass promotes rank46 as the minimal clean-and-noise-stable pooled program. A miss restores rank47 or rank48 according to which robustness metric failed; no threshold tuning is allowed.
